hazards.name: Lack of Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible for a long stretch, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected.
hazards.location_in_image: Mid-block area

hazards.name: Unprotected Midblock Crossing
hazards.description: The crossing markings are faded and lack accompanying signage or signals to alert drivers to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive Roadway Width
hazards.description: The wide, open roadway design encourages high vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals visible, forcing pedestrians to cross at unmarked locations across multiple lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible block

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The width of the roadway and lack of traffic calming measures likely encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Condition
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk is narrow, cracked, and overgrown with weeds, presenting trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side of the street along the wall

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk visible on the near side of the street, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and signage to designate a safe crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Replace the flexible bollards with a raised concrete refuge island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental patterns.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically for the sidewalk and crosswalk areas, especially under the elevated rail.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start to enter the crosswalk before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Permanent Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace the temporary yellow bollards with permanent concrete curb extensions to physically shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity pedestrian-scale lighting beneath the elevated structure to eliminate shadows and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking and stopping within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Convert the painted center median into a raised pedestrian refuge island to allow for safer two-stage crossings.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with continental markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to provide a clear path around the utility pole and create a more comfortable walking environment.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated crossing point for pedestrians across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for bike lanes or wider buffers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical buffer and improve the aesthetic quality of the walkway.

interventions.title: High-visibility mid-block crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and potentially a Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB) to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety along the blank wall at night.

interventions.title: Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install signage at the loading bay to alert exiting drivers to the presence of pedestrians and cyclists.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install R1-6 'State Law Yield to Pedestrians' signs or standard W11-2 pedestrian crossing warning signs.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Repurpose excess roadway width for protected bike lanes or wider sidewalks to slow traffic and reduce crossing exposure.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction and Widening
interventions.description: Repair and widen the existing sidewalk to meet ADA standards and provide a comfortable walking surface.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a new sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a continuous pedestrian network.
